blocks.text: Queue ke do basic (bunyadi) operations hain:

items: Enqueue (item jorna): jaise line ke aakhir mein naya shakhs lag jaye. Queue mein item peeche (back) jorte hain.
Dequeue (item nikalna): jaise line mein sab se aage wale shakhs ka kaam kar ke use bhej dena. Queue mein item aage (front) se nikalte hain.
Kuch aur operations bhi ho sakte hain: check karna ke queue khali hai ya nahi, aage wala item nikale baghair dekhna (peek), aur queue ka size maloom karna.

blocks.text:
# Built-in module to implement queues in python
from queue import Queue
# Create a new queue
q = Queue()
# Add people to the queue (Enqueue)
q.put("Ahmed")    # Adds Ahmed to the end of the queue
q.put("Fatima")   # Adds Fatima to the end of the queue
q.put("Ali")      # Adds Ali to the end of the queue
# View the person at the front of the queue (Peek)
front_person = q.queue[0]  # Looks at the person at the front without removing them
print(front_person)
# Remove a person from the front of the queue (Dequeue)
removed_person = q.get()   # Removes and returns the person at the front of the queue
print(removed_person)
# Add another person to the queue (Enqueue)
q.put("Sara")     # Adds Sara to the end of the queue
# View the updated queue
updated_queue = list(q.queue)
print(updated_queue)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein do ghaltiyan hain: (1) q.getO likha hai; aisa koi method nahi, is liye AttributeError aata hai; sahi q.get() hai. (2) updated_queue = list(q.queue) comment wali line par hi chhapa hai, is liye chalta nahi aur print(updated_queue) par NameError aata hai; upar ise alag line par likha gaya hai. Kitab mein " Ahmed" ke shuru mein ek space bhi hai, jo naam ke saath print hota hai; upar use hata diya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein: pehli mein put() ke baad Ahmed (aage), Fatima, Ali (peeche). Doosri mein get() ne Ahmed ko aage se nikal diya aur put() ne Sara ko peeche jor diya: Fatima, Ali, Sara.
blocks.caption: Queue mein put() aur get(): pehle aane wala pehle nikalta hai (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.text: Yeh code logon ki line ko queue se sambhalta hai. Pehle teen log line ke aakhir mein jorta hai (put), phir dekhta hai ke sab se aage kaun hai (q.queue[0], yaani peek), phir aage wale ko nikal deta hai (get). Aakhir mein ek aur shakhs (Sara) jor kar nayi line dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: 'peek' operation se queue ka sab se aage wala item nikale baghair dekha ja sakta hai. Yeh aisa hai jaise shelf par pehli kitab dekh lena ke agli baar kaunsi uthegi.

blocks.prompt: Queue mein item jorne ke liye kaunsa operation istemal hota hai (MCQ 5)? Enqueue aur dequeue mein farq bataiye (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: (c) Enqueue. Enqueue item ko queue ke peeche jorta hai; dequeue sab se aage wala item nikal kar wapas deta hai. Dono mil kar pehle aao, pehle pao (FIFO) wala order qaim rakhte hain.
